## Key Projects & Published Applications
- **DevMock:** Network simulation and traffic control testing tool for Android developers.
- **Dial Hash (Shortcodes):** USSD quick-dialing and offline transaction utility app.
- **Circle Pay:** Digital rotational savings and cooperative finance platform.
- **Nexgt Mall:** Multi-vendor African commerce platform.
- **Web Developer Utilities:** UUID Generator, JSON Formatter, JWT Decoder, and JS Sandbox at https://augustine.cobbold.dev/tools

## Core Technical Competencies
- **Mobile:** Android SDK, Kotlin, Java, Jetpack Compose, RoomDB, React Native, Expo, App Store & Google Play deployment.
- **Frontend / Full-stack:** Next.js (App Router), React, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, shadcn/ui.
- **Backend & Cloud:** Node.js, NestJS, PostgreSQL, Redis, Docker, Firebase, REST APIs.
- **Architecture Specialization:** Resilient offline sync, queue-based data synchronization, conflict resolution, mobile security.

## Technical Writing
- **Designing Offline Sync for Mobile Field Apps:** Architecture patterns, local data storage, queue-based uploads, conflict resolution, and network-aware synchronization.
- **Mobile Money Scams Are Rising: Here’s How to Protect Yourself:** Analysis of transaction fraud patterns and prevention in emerging markets.
- **Roadmap to Become an Android Developer in 2026:** Modern learning and engineering path from fundamentals to production-ready Android systems.
